segments.text:
BY the handes of the Apoſtles were manye ſygnes and wonders ſhewed among the people. And they were all together with one accorde in Salomons
porche. And of other durſt no man ioine hymſelfe to them: neuertheles the people magnified them. The noumber of thē that beleued in the Lord, both of men & weomē, grewe more & more: in ſo muche that they brought the ſicke into the ſtretes, and laied them on beddes and couches, that at the leaſt way the ſhadow of Peter, whē he came by, myght ſhadow ſome of them (and that they might al be deliuered from their infirmites.) There came alſo a multitude out of the cities rounde about, vnto Ieruſalem, bringyng ſicke folkes, and them which were vexed with vncleane ſpirites: And they were healed euery one.
